values: 一名武艺超群的射手，能够同时发射数枚箭矢攻击敌人。
An incredibly skilled archer who can fire several arrows at once to hit targets.
All set... I await your command.
There's some tension... What's going on?
手指和手腕都要保持灵活。
Keep your hands steady... Don't lose focus.
A demonstration? Very well. Aim... Fire.
Thank you. It's just what I needed.
I appreciate it. I'll take it.
守护吧，即使沉沦于比夜晚更深沉的黑暗。
Stand your ground, even as you sink into a darkness deeper than night itself.
熔火将他的誓言，铸为牢不可破的坚甲。
Ferocious flames cast his oath into unyielding armor.
完成剧情任务“神明的声音”特定环节获得。
Complete Story Quest - First Flame's Chosen
One needs to adapt to change...
That was a hearty meal. I ate way too much.
因度厄是萨洛克兰历史上第一位加入王城卫队的平民。像这样的“第一”记录，在他的生涯中简直数不胜数，在将来还会继续增加。
Indris is the first commoner ever to join the Sal'thorin Guard, and that is just one of many groundbreaking achievements under his belt.
无论怎样恶劣的地形，因度厄都能自如地攀爬、跳跃、奔行——就像一道迅疾而致命的黑影。
Indris can navigate across the harshest terrain, climbing, leaping, and sprinting effortlessly like a shadow.
尽管因度厄看起来不好接近，但他其实有不少仰慕者，甚至在萨洛克兰贵族少女的理想情人排行榜中，他常年位居前三。
Indris may come off as unapproachable, but he has no shortage of admirers, as seen by his consistent ranking among the top three most eligible bachelors in the eyes of Sal'thorin's young noblewomen.
因度厄不善言辞，也不善社交，所以他所有朋友都是主动找上门来的，而因度厄尽管从未付诸言语，但经常在心中默默感谢这份友情。
Indris is quite the introvert, so every friendship he has is forged by someone else reaching out to him first. Though he has never put it into words, he holds those friendships close to his heart.
都铎曾经极端反对平民加入卫队，但因度厄的出色表现激起了他同为武者的惺惺相惜，反而让他率先投出了赞成票。

Thador had once vehemently opposed the idea of commoners joining the guard, but after witnessing Indris' stellar performance, he was thoroughly convinced. In the end, he became the first to vote in favor of Indris.
因度厄对食物的口味没有任何偏好，无论什么，他都能像是没有味觉一般面不改色地吃下去——但奇妙的是，他厨艺居然相当不错。
Indris isn't picky about food, but strangely enough, he happens to be an excellent cook.
因度厄有着出众的动态视觉，据说他能瞬间看清数十只飞蛾的飞舞轨迹，并准确射中有标记的那几只。
Indris possesses extraordinary dynamic vision. It is said that he can track the flight patterns of dozens of moths simultaneously and strike his marked targets with deadly precision.
因度厄滴酒不沾，不仅是因为自律，也是因为他一杯必醉，而酒品更是异常的差。
Indris doesn't drink, not just because he is disciplined, but also due to his low alcohol tolerance. Worse still, when he does get drunk, his behavior turns unpredictably erratic.
因度厄不太擅长日常闲聊，刚认识斐利尔时，只要碰面，他就会异常主动地过来搭话，这甚至让因度厄一度更改了自己的巡视路线。

Indris isn't great at small talk. When Feli and him first met, Feli would always strike up a conversation whenever their paths crossed. To avoid running into him, Indris even changed his patrol route for a while.
“别看他那个样子，实际上特别爱操心，想让他追在你屁股后头收拾，就尽情地惹点无伤大雅的麻烦吧。”某位不愿透露姓名的面具男子如是说。

"Don't be fooled by his poker face—he actually cares a lot about those around him. Want him to clean up your mess? Just stir up some harmless trouble every now and then," commented a masked man who wished to remain anonymous.
那是在我当上卫队成员不久后，因为某些事情，在银月祭庭外徘徊。
One day, I was wandering outside the Lunaris Altar, lost in thought. It was shortly after I joined the guard.
这不是我的木头卫队长和他的得力助手嘛。
Well, if it isn't the strait-laced Captain Indris and his right-hand man!
如果你在野外遇到孽化之人，虽然心理会难以承受……
When you run into the Sinned Ones in the wilderness, it's hard not to feel sympathy for them...
在地底守卫不可告人的秘密……将军，这就是你对萨洛克兰的守护方式？
Guarding the secrets underground... General, is that your way of protecting Sal'thorin?
能从平民中被选拔为卫兵，再被选为卫队长是很幸运的事。
To become a guard and then the captain as a commoner, I must say l'm a fortunate one.
如果我能更早察觉艾塞勒生活在谎言之中，揭开这所有欺骗的真相……
If I had discovered the truth sooner...
偶尔到地面上散散步，透透气，真不错嘛。
It's nice to take a walk on the surface and get some fresh air.
朝阳东升，晚霞夕照，月亮与繁星散发光辉……
The morning sun rises in the east, followed by the evening glow that paints the sky. Finally, the moon and stars radiate their brilliance at night...
沙利叶让我前往地表的目的，或许是为了验证我说出口的“真相”。
I think I know why Ravion sent me here—maybe he wanted to test the truth I spoke of.
奈萨雷斯的残暴统治结束了，接下来的管理应当更温和一些。
Now that Seralyth's tyranny has ended. May the next ruler govern with a lighter hand.
新生的树该怎么照顾呢。
How does one take care of a newborn tree?
That was a hearty meal. I ate way too much.
